services.desc: Surf Experience on Lake Powell About Lake Powell draws crowds from all over the world. Cruise the waters of Lake Powell without having to worry about driving the boat yourself. Your captain will take you to the best spots on the lake in our top-of-the-line boats. We have boats perfect for any sports whether you want to be pulled on a tube, go waterskiing, wakeboarding, wake surfing, knee boarding, while also simply enjoying a day out on the water. This tour includes the boat, a Coast Guard licensed captain, cold water to drink and any water toys you may need. If you have never done water sports and you are looking to learn, we got you covered.
